claims: NASA currently projects the Artemis III mission to launch in 2027.
Artemis II flight is scheduled for 2026.
Artemis III mission follows the Artemis II flight.
Artemis III is designed to test critical rendezvous and docking capabilities in low Earth orbit with commercial landers from SpaceX and Blue Origin.
Artemis III is designed to prepare for a subsequent crewed lunar landing on Artemis IV in 2028.
Artemis III mission goal is to test new Extravehicular Activity (xEVA) suits in orbit.
Artemis III mission goal is to test integrated life support in orbit.
Artemis III mission goal is to test propulsion systems in orbit.
Artemis III will utilize commercial landers.
Artemis III partnerships include SpaceX (Starship HLS).
Artemis III partnerships include Blue Origin.
Artemis III crew will launch from Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Artemis III crew will launch on the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis III timeline was updated in early 2026.
Artemis III timeline was updated to focus on ensuring the readiness of essential technologies for long-term exploration.
